Aditya / Grace,

Following up with the technical evidence. Root cause: a transient IAM role misbinding during a rolling deployment on 2026-07-14 that allowed an elevated admin role to persist for ~18 minutes. Remediation actions (completed 2026-07-15):
- Reverted the deployment and patched the orchestration script to validate role bindings before promotion.
- Backfilled RBAC audit entries and created an automated policy to block role grants without multi-approval.
- Added an alert rule to detect short-lived elevation anomalies; test coverage added to our CI jobs.

Attached: logs_export_20261127.csv (filtered access events post-remediation), investigation_notes_F-2026-03.txt

Evidence notes:
- The logs show no further admin elevation events after 2026-07-15.
- We can produce a signed timestamped export if the auditors require chain-of-custody verification.

If Beacon needs a formal control update or supplemental wording in the bridge letter about compensating controls, I can draft that language.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
